description.value: Donald's Market is a locally owned neighbourhood grocery store on East Hastings Street in East Vancouver, operating since 1986 and a multiple-time winner of Best Grocery Store in Vancouver. The store emphasises organic, natural, non-GMO, and gluten-free products, with roughly 90% of its inventory sourced from local BC businesses such as Salt Spring Coffee, Uprising Breads, and Artisan Bake Shoppe. Touring cyclists passing through East Vancouver will find a well-stocked, community-minded grocery with a broad selection of whole and specialty foods.
